#### Edit 2: Add Capacitive Feedback for Wideband Stability and Matching
This edit introduces a capacitive feedback path from the output to the input gate. While not as effective as resistive feedback in improving S11, it can help stabilize the input impedance and improve matching in certain frequency regions.
